title: SessionToolSurfaceChanged
description: Params of the session.toolSurfaceChanged server-to-client notification: whether the launch-owned nocx worker tool surface is reachable. The fact is emitted only after the endpoint admits a launch and either receives tools.catalogue or reaches its deadline/refusal, so absence before settlement is not a failure shown to the user.

sessionId.description: The session whose launch owns this tool surface.

instanceId.description: The backend instance that minted the session.

sessionEpoch.description: The session incarnation within the backend instance.

status.description: Whether the launch-owned worker tool surface is available.

reason.description: Why the worker tool surface is unavailable. Required only for unavailable facts and never sent for available facts.
